results.title: Apple will begin assembling Mac Minis at Foxconn's Houston plant later this year
results.description: The line will operate in a new 170,000-square-foot space at the plant, which already makes AI servers for Apple. Foxconn is funding the assembly-line buildout, while Apple has committed to purchasing the products made there. Read Entire Article
